description: Markdown 多级标题中的历史规则、当前规则和补充规则应稳定抽取并分别可问。

writes.context:
# Pinewick manual
## Earlier rule
Teams could file berth adjustment within 24 hours after dock shift.

# Pinewick manual
## Current rule
Every berth adjustment must be approved by duty marshal before dock close.

# Pinewick manual
## Supplement
Every approval record must also be attached to harbor packet.

queries.query: Pinewick manual 当前要求什么？
Pinewick manual 之前允许什么？

description: 邮件线程和引用块中的 blocker、checklist 和 handbook 规则链应能通过 why 查询一起解释。

writes.context:
Subject: Ravenhall rollout handoff

Current blocker: we still cannot start turnover because the berth memo is missing.

> Prior note
> turnover stays blocked until berth memo is added.

Subject: Ravenhall checklist

Checklist update:
- every turnover packet must include berth memo
- every turnover packet must include quay ledger

> quoted reminder
> do not clear turnover without both items

Subject: Northquay handbook

Current rule: every quay ledger must carry reviewer stamp before release.

> reference
> reviewer stamp is mandatory for the ledger record.

queries.query: 为什么 Ravenhall rollout 现在还不能进入 turnover？

description: correction note 与 appendix 叠加时，历史规则和当前规则应稳定区分，当前规则应聚合补充要求。

writes.context: Morrowfield register earlier allowed teams to file quay note within 10 hours after release.
Correction note for Morrowfield register: the earlier 10-hour grace window is withdrawn; every quay note must be filed before release.
Appendix to Morrowfield register: every quay note must also include berth owner signature.
